learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn about mirror halves, dividing shapes equally, and the beautiful magic of symmetry!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When you fold a shape in half and both sides match perfectly, it is called symmetrical. It is exactly like looking at a reflection in a mirror!
The fold line that divides a shape into two equal halves is called the line of symmetry. Some shapes have one line, and some have many.
Butterflies, green leaves, and even human faces have beautiful natural symmetry. If you draw an imaginary line down the middle, both sides look the same.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Butterfly Ink Fold
fun_activity.instructions: Put a drop of wet paint on one side of a folded paper. Press it closed tightly, then open it to see a perfect symmetrical butterfly!

quick_recap: ⭐ Symmetrical shapes have two halves that match each other exactly.
⭐ The line of symmetry divides a shape into perfect mirror halves.
⭐ Symmetry makes shapes, designs, and nature look very beautiful and perfectly balanced.
